description:
Record a veterinary treatment for a sick animal. A cow named 'Marguerite' (Work ID: 9001) needs to be treated with 50ml of 'Curamycin'. 

Navigate to the Interventions section in Ekylibre and create a new intervention. Select the category for Sanitary/Health/Veterinary care. Set the Target to 'Marguerite'. Add an Input line for the product 'Curamycin' with a quantity of 50. Save the intervention.
